source.section: MD&A · Capital Resources and Liquidity · Capital Expenditures · Six Months Ended June 30, 2026 (YTD)
source.quote: The total aggregate amount paid for purchased and developed software, contract costs, and purchases of property and equipment was $88.2 million and $53.4 million for the six months ended June 30, 2026 and 2025, respectively.

source.section: MD&A · Share Repurchases and Dividends · Six Months Ended June 30, 2026 (YTD); StockTitan wire recap of the Q2 2026 press release independently states $64.0 million YTD buybacks — the 10-Q figure ($53.7M, excluding commissions) is used here as the primary-source value
source.quote: During the six months ended June 30, 2026 and 2025, 5.7 million and 14.8 million shares were repurchased under this authorization for $53.7 million and $149.7 million, respectively, excluding commissions.
Our Board of Directors declared quarterly cash dividends of $0.235 per common share in the first and second quarters of 2026, representing $147.0 million in total dividends.
